# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 7 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in 1QH Column 7 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 7:1 — "maqor" — "source" vs. "fountain" (second term)

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a spring of water" | Literal ma'yan |
| LOGOS | "a fountain of water" | Elevated |
| PNEUMA | "a water spring" | Reversed order |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "a spring of water." Natural for a water source.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 7:4 — "ma'yan seter" — "secret spring" vs. "hidden spring"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a secret spring" | Literal seter |
| LOGOS | "a hidden spring" | Natural English |
| PNEUMA | "a hidden spring" | Same |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "a hidden spring" (LOGOS/PNEUMA). More natural.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS/PNEUMA.

---

## 7:5 — "'olam" — "eternal" vs. "everlasting"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "an eternal planting" | "eternal" |
| LOGOS | "an everlasting planting" | "everlasting" |
| PNEUMA | "an everlasting grove" | Dynamic with "grove" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "an everlasting planting." Living, growing quality.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 7:9 — "'atsei mayim" — "trees of water" vs. "trees by the water"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "trees of water" | Literal construct |
| LOGOS | "trees by the water" | Interpreted locative |
| PNEUMA | "waterside trees" | Compound |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "trees by the water." More natural English.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 7:12 — "sarakta" — "fenced" vs. "guarded" vs. "protected"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "fenced" | Agricultural |
| LOGOS | "guarded" | Military context |
| PNEUMA | "protected" | General |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "guarded." Context is military (warriors, spirits, flame).

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 7:13 — Genesis 3:24 allusion — "turning flame" vs. "whirling flame"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the turning flame of fire" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "the whirling flame of fire" | "whirling" for mithappekhet |
| PNEUMA | "the swirling sword of flame" | Adds "sword" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "the whirling flame of fire." Vivid; PNEUMA's "sword" not in text.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 7:17 — "le-cherpah" — "scorn" vs. "object of scorn"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the scorn of" | Concise |
| LOGOS | "an object of scorn to" | Full formal |
| PNEUMA | "something they mock" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "the scorn of." Concise and punchy.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 7:28 — "yashkenu" — "dwell" vs. "shelter"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "dwell in it" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "shelter in it" | Protective sense |
| PNEUMA | "find shelter under it" | Expanded |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "shelter in it." Captures protective function.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 7:33 — "meqor" — "source" vs. "wellspring"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "an eternal source" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "an eternal wellspring" | Evocative |
| PNEUMA | "an eternal water source" | Descriptive |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "an eternal wellspring." Beautiful and precise.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 7:37 — Psalm 1:3 echo — singular vs. plural "leaf/leaves"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "its leaves do not wither" | Plural |
| LOGOS | "its leaf does not wither" | Singular, Psalm 1:3 |
| PNEUMA | "its leaves never wither" | Plural |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "its leaf does not wither." Preserves Psalm 1:3 echo.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

**Total disagreements in Column 7: 10**
